newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris June same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris June same-store sales up.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc said Thursday its same store sales for June rose four percent.
Net sales increased six percent to $15.0 million from $14.2 million a year go.
Year-to-date, same store sales increased eight percent. Total sales rose nine percent to $72.9 million from $66.7 million.
"We were very pleased to announce the 17th consecutive month of positive comparable store sales," Charlotte Fischer, chairman, said in a statement.
Paul Harris is a specialty retailer with 225 stores.
